scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sop/contracts && npm run build --workspace @sop/backend && npm run build --workspace @sop/frontend && npm run build --workspace @sop/infra
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sop/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @sop/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @sop/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace @sop/infra
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @sop/backend && npm run test --workspace @sop/frontend && npm run test --workspace @sop/infra

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace @sop/infra
